name: God IS Drunk（宿醉阿弥陀佛）
detailed_description:
This is a 2.5D obstacle avoidance game with a collage art style. You will control the characters as they race down the streets, dodging obstacles, and defeating the BOSS at the end of the road. Navigate through various complex road conditions to reach your destination.

The game features multiple levels, each with its own unique mechanics and BOSS. They are the obstacles in your path, but in the end, you can leave them all behind.

Booze? BOOZE!

Between the dusk and dawn of the world, embark on a hangover journey.

You'll lead three drunkards pushing their motorcycles and running wild on the streets, carrying years of treasured fine liquor, racing through the apocalyptic city while dodging anything that could knock you down, ultimately rushing toward that old buddy you haven't seen in ages!

In the remaining time, fill each other's bodies with as much alcohol as possible! The road is perilous, but when you come to your senses, you're already drinking like there's no tomorrow!

Swaying Glasses & Stumbling Steps

This game offers a brief experience (under 30 minutes) and can serve as the perfect companion to a pint of beer.

In this game, you can feel the swaying after getting drunk and the headache after a hangover! Plus, hear three drunkards complain about this crappy world! Everything on the road is an obstacle—don't let them hit anything... except booze! And don't expect them to actually ride the motorcycles, because everyone knows you can't drink and drive.

You can only pray to God that they run faster, and that the beat-up secondhand modified bike doesn't fall apart halfway through.

But maybe the drunkards will fall apart first—who knows?

Savoring Life's Many Flavors

How did Earth suddenly decide to end? Nobody knows. Maybe God just got drunk.

But clearly, many people aren't hungover—they still know to flee to safety when doomsday arrives (unlike me).

The apocalypse reveals sides of them never seen before. You can listen to their stories, or choose not to.

After all, truth only comes out when drunk, and since they're sober, they're just talking nonsense.

The Night the Comet Arrives

The game isn't difficult at all. Trust that you can still beat it even while hungover (but minors are prohibited from drinking, and this game doesn't promote drinking either).

This game contains no personal expression whatsoever. If there is any, it's all in the booze. Cheers!

Since Earth's about to be destroyed anyway, why not get drunk?

*This game is based on true events

*Erguotou is the world's finest baijiu

short_description: Liquor is grain's essence—drink more, age less. With love, anything becomes booze. Humans are 70% water, but hungover men are 100% alcohol! Right now, as doomsday begins, three hungover men rush toward the apocalypse's center for one last drink with a long-lost friend.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
